info.description: Authentication, users, posts, messaging, notifications, dive locations, and learn content. Authenticated API endpoints use JWT Bearer tokens.
info.title: ScubaPal API

get.description: Returns one published scuba education article by slug.
Returns dive locations, optionally filtered by city.
Returns profile details for the authenticated user.

put.description: Updates profile details for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns paged conversations for the authenticated user.

post.description: Finds or creates a direct-message conversation with another user.

get.description: Returns unread message and notification counters for the authenticated user.
Returns paged direct messages for a conversation and marks unread items as read.

post.description: Sends a message to a conversation participant.
Marks all unread messages in a conversation as read for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns paged notifications for the authenticated user.
Returns unread notification count for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Marks one notification as read for the authenticated user.

post.description: Marks one notification as read for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns active public diver profiles visible to all users.
Returns profile details for a user.

post.description: Creates a profile for a user if one does not already exist.

put.description: Updates profile details for a user.

get.description: Returns paged dive shops, optionally filtered by shop name, city, state, country, or linked dive location.

delete.description: Removes a follow relationship for the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a follow relationship from the authenticated user to the target user.

get.description: Returns follower/following counts and whether the current user follows the target user.
Returns a read-only paged list of users following the target user.
Returns a read-only paged list of users followed by the target user.
Returns profile details for a user.
